candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A valid failure is a concrete FormulaEval rule with no RowSetEnumerator_N yet an advice-free UExt quotient witness binding every row parity at subexpansion cost.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Paper-support bridge lemma: classifies FormulaEval-SAT into charged expansion or semantic countermodel before promoting the parser theorem.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For transparent Psys_sym^sel, each FormulaEval-SAT mechanism either has an advice-free RowSetEnumerator_N and pays N E_N expansion in Gamma, or it is a semantic-oracle escape with a private unread eval-critical bit countermodel.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot or quarantine if a concrete Psys_sym selector cannot expose RowSet(a) and no eval-critical private-bit countermodel can be formalized.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote after proving RowSetEnumerator_N for a named selector fragment or publishing the minimal unread-bit countermodel with the Gamma_sym inequality.
control_decision.reason: The branch improved the top queue item by naming the FormulaEval expansion charge, private-bit countermodel, and RowSetEnumerator_N gap without broadening to new carriers.

dependency_updates.description: Inherited as closed for Psys_bEF^-; used as the base of the FormulaEval extension audit.
Sharpened to expansion-or-private-row dichotomy for transparent Psys_sym^sel FormulaEval lines.
Must enumerate eval-critical occurrence neighborhoods for interval-union or AC0 selectors without semantic advice.
Only allowed escape from expansion if it supplies an advice-free quotient witness for FormulaEval-SAT identity.

falsifiers: Private-row falsifier: an unread eval-critical formula bit at (x*,j*) gives two completions with identical transcript and different row parity.
Advice leakage falsifier: RowSet chosen by a hardwired hard row set is not uniform and cannot transfer to the target language class.
Threshold falsifier: if q>=epsilon, the N^{1+q+o(1)} expansion no longer gives a subthreshold refutation of LB_N(1+epsilon).
Semantic-oracle falsifier: FormulaEval returning SAT truth without occurrence exposure is outside the controlled interface unless witnessed by an advice-free quotient.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: For beta<1+q an unread eval-critical pair should yield a private-row countermodel; at beta=1+q the parser pays full expansion and the low-cost proof claim loses its escape.
held_fixed_controls: M_N=N^{q+o(1)} and each formula has polylogarithmic length.
The target lower-bound sentence LB_N(1+epsilon) and nonuniform circuit model are unchanged.
The generator G_N is uniform with overhead N^{rho+o(1)} and no advice.
SATeq and bounded-SR_h subrules remain within the proved Psys_bEF^- parser.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The branch needs a concrete FormulaEval boundary test, not another MCSP slogan, because the remaining proof gap is exactly expansion versus private unread bit.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: A padded SAT-query family G_N^beta where H_N(x)=xor_{j<=N^q} SAT(G_N(x,j)); Psys_sym has a FormulaEval rule exposing only N^beta row-query occurrence records and semantically answering the rest.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A uniform RowSetEnumerator_N plus an eval-critical-bit lemma, or a formal UExtWitnessability certificate showing semantic equality is advice-free and target-preserving.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: beta, the exponent of exposed row-query occurrence records, from beta<1+q to beta=1+q.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 100 converts the remaining FormulaEval-SAT fork into a finite theorem packet: transparent mechanisms pay N^{1+q+o(1)} expansion, while nontransparent ones face a private-row falsifier unless UExtWitnessability is valid. This supports the paper obstruction theorem only.

negative_tactic_decision.conflict_target: Claim that a low-cost carrier transcript proves language hardness while only selecting or semantically asserting hard rows.
negative_tactic_decision.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: Private-row/unread-bit countermodels and N^{1+q+o(1)} expansion-charge no-go theorems for low-cost transcripts.
escape_conditions: Advice-free RowSetEnumerator_N for every FormulaEval line.
Searchable UExt quotient witness binding formula identity in the same proof system.
Density and cost parameters q<epsilon, rho<1+epsilon, with no natural-size property projection.
negative_tactic_decision.exact_negation_or_method_class: Negate target-preserving transfer by finding FormulaEval-SAT, row selectors, or truth-table ranking mechanisms that use advice, semantic oracles, or unexposed eval-critical bits.
negative_tactic_decision.next_validation_handoff: Send FE100 to pvsnp-symbolic-complexity-auditor, quantifier-uniformity reviewer, and impossibility-theorem forger for exact RowSet and countermodel validation.
negative_tactic_decision.paper_contribution_potential: Paper-level scoped theorem if RowSetEnumerator_N is proved for a named fragment, or paper-level boundary if the unread-bit countermodel is formalized.
proof_obligations: Name G_N, H_N^SAT, M_N, formula length, selector class, and certificate/proof size.
Check whether RowSet selection uses advice, ranking, or nonuniform hard-row choice.
Test private-row completions and easy sparse tables as falsifiers.
Derive Gamma_sym, not merely assert the transcript upper bound.
negative_tactic_decision.reason_for_tactic: The live risk is that proof or MCSP-style carriers hide row hardness in semantic FormulaEval values rather than uniform language computation.

branch_outputs.next_experiment: Instantiate RowSetEnumerator_N for interval-union selectors: write bit fields for row intervals, enumerate all (x,j,bit) contacts, prove E_N=N^{q+o(1)}, or exhibit the smallest unread eval-critical formula bit.

escape_conditions: advice-free parser or residual decoder is proved for the named proof-system fragment
unwitnessed semantic SAT/extensionality use is isolated as a model change rather than promoted
all transfer exponents and row-support charges remain below the claimed source threshold
barrier_status.trigger: route-specific proof/certificate extraction can overclaim if semantic SAT rules, advice, or transfer exponents are not charged

correctness_criteria: reduction direction and transfer inequality are stated before claiming target progress
length, exponent, uniformity, advice, and proof-system regimes match between source and target
barrier status is attached to the exact proof/certificate mechanism, not used as a slogan
semantic SAT rules are either witnessed and charged or quarantined as model changes

derivation_status.blocked_obligation: RowSetEnumerator_N is still unproved for full Psys_sym; it is ready only for transparent selector fragments such as interval-union or AC0 row selectors.

failure_modes: occurrence-label reasoning is silently upgraded to full SAT semantics
hidden advice or nonuniform row selection enters the parser or residual decoder
the branch repeats the semantic fork without proving extraction, countermodel, or named escape
the result is described as P vs NP progress rather than a scoped route-control theorem

model_context.oracle_status: oracle-free unless an unwitnessed SAT-semantic/extensionality rule is explicitly quarantined as semantic-oracle escape

model_context.target_class: route-specific P vs NP consequence; no claim of P != NP or SAT notin P/poly without all-exponent transfer

parameter_map.transfer_formula: if the named proof/certificate parser has subthreshold residual or cover cost, then patching gives a small circuit for H_N^SAT; otherwise the branch must pay the declared row/support threshold

side_conditions: source object and target object are the ones stated in the candidate lemma definitions
the parser, residual decoder, row-support set, and proof-system rules must be advice-free or explicitly quarantined
the result remains a scoped route audit and does not claim P != NP
Length regime N->infty; M_N=N^{q+o(1)}; each G_N(x,j) has log^{O(1)} N bits; rho,q,epsilon are fixed constants.
Gap98-SRhNormalForm is inherited for Psys_bEF^-; Gamma_bEF(pi) is a valid line-induction ledger for non-FormulaEval rules.

pvsnp_inference_quality.target_statement: target object: same-model nonuniform circuit upper bound for H_N^SAT, yielding a falsifier to LB_N when below N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}.

cycle_learning: This research cycle converted active route pressure into typed branch lemmas. The main mathematical change is that each branch now names a source object, target object, equation, validity condition, falsifier, and next experiment. Only research-mode cycles with elapsed-time and branch-engine evidence count as genuine long-horizon research progress.

Instantiate the odd-charge Tseitin parity-ambiguity test inside the named DCS-LC local projection system: list the tested projections, construct two projection-identical labelings with opposite row parity or prove that a checked global parity axiom prevents them.
No current proof supplies a uniform logarithmic-projection cluster with DirectClusterSound(C,k) for SAT lower bounds. The gap is local target soundness, not proof length or global PCP soundness.

The remaining open validation is proving row-parity SAT-semantic binding for the named DCS-LC proof system. Local consistency, ordinary soundness, or cluster agreement alone does not imply this binding; an odd-charge Tseitin-style parity ambiguity remains a concrete falsifier.
